searchText: Just a heads up: I merged in the Glamsterdam chain bump for execution-apis/rpc-compat. Will keep an eye on the runs/failures and continue addressing findings as they come up. This should unblock a bunch of other work and allow a bunch of PRs to rebase on main to become mergable too.

excerpts.content:
Just a heads up: I merged in the Glamsterdam chain bump for execution-apis/rpc-compat.

Will keep an eye on the runs/failures and continue addressing findings as they come up. This should unblock a bunch of other work and allow a bunch of PRs to rebase on main to become mergable too.
